purpose: Reusable hypothesis-swappable research harness; one record per line, grep by kind to read selectively

text: Separate the FIXED method from the SWAPPABLE parameters. Replay on a new hypothesis = keep method, refill parameters. The reusable weight is the lens taxonomy: it makes a study triangulated, not an echo chamber.

name: Frame & scope
does: State hypothesis as a question; name competing options; set scope/audience; list cross-cuts; declare options given-not-exhaustive

name: Source discovery
does: One BLIND agent per lens maps trusted sources (who/what, why-durable, must-read); does NOT answer; includes pattern-scout

name: Scope gate
does: Human blesses scope: resolve split-offs, add counterweight lens if one-sided, set deliverable target

name: Deep dive
does: One agent per option + one per cross-cut + pattern-scout, grounded in mapped sources; structured findings

name: Adversarial verify
does: One default-skeptical refuter per load-bearing claim; verdict + survives-as

name: Synthesize
does: One top-model agent writes the report: even-handed map first, then flagged [LEAN] + steelmanned dissent

purpose: Ground truth of the field itself
The durable tradition the hypothesis rests on

sources: a nearby field whose methods illuminate
risk, governance, the cost nobody is pricing
rule: Must dissent; if every lens agrees you mapped an echo chamber

purpose: Find options beyond the given set (the 4th/5th)

title: Beyond the options - emergent patterns (FLAGGED, rated for promotion)
What would change the answer (2-3 flip-facts)

rationale: grounded research + refutation = mid tier; the single keystone synthesis = top tier

desc: the question/claim under study, one sentence
5-8 entries: {type, topic, seedSources[]}; force >=1 dissenting counterweight
themes that cut across ALL options
load-bearing claims to refute: each option's strongest + the recommendation's load-bearers
map | decision | design (or a~b blend, lean flagged)

text: Pick 5-8 lenses by type; give each topic + seedSources; force >=1 dissenting counterweight
Run phase 2 (blind source discovery) -> save <study>.source-map.<date>.md. GATE.
Derive claims from the source map
